title: ElixirConf 2021 - Isaac Yonemoto - Zig (heart) Elixir
summary: Isaac Yonemoto's ElixirConf 2021 talk on Zigler, a library for writing Elixir NIFs in Zig. He looks at its internals and how it bridges the two languages while keeping the NIFs well behaved on the BEAM.
why: HN threads on Zig and Elixir link it as the creator's explanation of how Zig NIFs can behave nicely inside the BEAM.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: The creator of Zigler has a talk from ElixirConf 2021 on how he made Zig NIFs behave nicely
